elements.title: Progress toward carbon neutral
elements.content: A stacked bar chart showing baseline emissions, emissions reductions, and total iMac emissions for iMac (two ports) with 256GB: 1. Baseline emissions: 445 kg total CO2e, split into Materials and process emissions, Electricity for manufacturing, Electricity for product use, and Transportation. 2. Emissions reductions: -99 kg CO2e reduction total, achieved through Recycled and low-carbon materials, Low-carbon electricity, and Non-air shipping. 3. iMac emissions: 346 kg total CO2e, consisting of Materials and process emissions, Electricity for manufacturing, Electricity for product use, Transportation, and Renewable energy emissions.
